# COMMITTEE ON HUMAN RESOURCES/INSURANCE
## September 1, 2026 Immediately Following Committee on Administration

Chairman Goonan called the meeting to order.

The Clerk called the roll.

Present: Aldermen Goonan, Sapienza, O'Neil, Burkush

Absent: Alderman Vincent

1. Communication from the Human Resources Director requesting the creation and addition of one (1) full-time Payroll Administrator II position, grade 117, to the department's complement.

On motion of Alderman O'Neil, duly seconded by Alderman Burkush, it was voted to approve.

On motion of Alderman O'Neil, duly seconded by Alderman Sapienza, it was voted to expedite the committee's report to the full Board.

2. Communication from the Human Resources Director requesting that one (1) Benefits Manager position be modified from grade 118 to grade 119, and that the position's class specification be updated.

On motion of Alderman Burkush, duly seconded by Alderman Sapienza, it was voted to approve.

On motion of Alderman O'Neil, duly seconded by Alderman Burkush, it was voted to expedite the committee's report to the full Board.

3. Communication from Tom Malafronte, Aviation Director, requesting the following changes to the department's complement:

- Create two (2) Accountant II positions, grade 113
- Eliminate two (2) Accountant I positions, grade 108

On motion of Alderman Burkush, duly seconded by Alderman O'Neil, it was voted to approve.

On motion of Alderman O'Neil, duly seconded by Alderman Burkush, it was voted to expedite the committee's report to the full Board.

4. Communication from Ken Loui, Assistant Chief of Police, requesting the addition of two full-time Parking Control Officer positions to the Parking Division complement.

On motion of Alderman Burkush, duly seconded by Alderman O'Neil, it was voted to approve.

On motion of Alderman O'Neil, duly seconded by Alderman Burkush, it was voted to expedite the committee's report to the full Board.

There being no further business, on motion of Alderman Sapienza, duly seconded by Alderman O'Neil, it was voted to adjourn.

A True Record. Attest.

Clerk of Committee

Meeting Start Time: 6:25PM
Meeting End Time: 6:27PM
Minutes Prepared By: Michael Intranuovo
headline: Approved four personnel and staffing changes across Human Resources, Aviation, and Police departments and voted to expedite each to the full Board.
summary: The committee approved creating a Payroll Administrator II position, upgrading a Benefits Manager position's grade, adding two Accountant II positions while eliminating two Accountant I positions in Aviation, and adding two Parking Control Officer positions. Each item was also voted to be expedited to the full Board.
decisions: Approved creation and addition of one (1) full-time Payroll Administrator II position, grade 117, to the Human Resources Director's department's complement.
Voted to expedite the Payroll Administrator II item to the full Board.
Approved modifying one (1) Benefits Manager position from grade 118 to grade 119 and updating its class specification.
Voted to expedite the Benefits Manager item to the full Board.
Approved creating two (2) Accountant II positions, grade 113, and eliminating two (2) Accountant I positions, grade 108, in the Aviation department.
Voted to expedite the Aviation department complement item to the full Board.
Approved adding two full-time Parking Control Officer positions to the Parking Division complement.
Voted to expedite the Parking Control Officer item to the full Board.
